summary.text: On Zendikar, where the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek are loose, Gideon, Jace, Nissa and Chandra swear an oath to stand together and found the Gatewatch.
After Chandra frees the others from Ob Nixilis, who has been seeking the Eldrazi's power, the Gatewatch binds both titans in a web of leylines.
Chandra then channels her fire through Nissa and the ley lines, destroying both titans, though Ugin berates Jace and his friends for killing them.
